title: ProtectPlus
description: This mod adds the ability to change the protection level.
body:
## 📖 What is this mod?
### English
Protect Plus is a mod that allows you to change the protection percentage for 1 piece of armor.

### Русский
Protect Plus это мод позволяющий менять процент защиты за 1 часть брони.

<details>
<summary>Configuration File</summary>


```js
[settings]
	#enable/disable mod
	enabled = true
	#how much % protection give 1 armor
	protectionPerArmor = 4.0
	#max % protaction
	maxProtection = 80.0
	#min damage
	minDamage = 0.0

```


</details>
